title: The Truth Behind Calorie Labels
summary: Casey Neistat's short New York Times op-doc investigating how accurate restaurant and packaged-food calorie labels really are. He gets items from chains like Chipotle, Starbucks and Subway measured by nutrition researchers and compares them to the printed numbers.
why: Cited in threads on calorie counting as a quick, visual demonstration that labeled calories can be well off.

quote.text: Casey Neistat made a fun little video[1] that explores this a bit.
